title: A measure of finite positive total mass is not of the form Hⁿ.withDensity f with f(t·w) = f(w) for all t > 0, when n ≥ 1 (parent step 6)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, ν a measure on ℝ^P with ν(ℝ^P) ≠ 0 and ν(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞, and f : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] an arbitrary function (no measurability assumed) with f(t·w) = f(w) for every t > 0 and w ∈ ℝ^P. Then ν ≠ μHE[n].withDensity f.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), 1 ≤ n → ν univ ≠ 0 → ν univ ≠ ∞ → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ w : Euclid P, f (t • w) = f w) → ν ≠ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f
